notes.title: Riverguard update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/5ba9ed5fda5191fe7e06d8a856f74f3af7030ed0.png
The riverguard update brings a lot of nice things.

A new opening scene and a new starting zone when you begin your adventure in Riverguard.

All the levels now have a darker tone and spells shine in the darkness.

A new look for Eria and Argos spells. 

A better aim-system for gamepad using aim-bow as default.

One more Bad Fate, for a total of Ten !

Two more books !

Breakable objects and Burden Bats !

Some nicer pixel here and there.


So, ready your WASD or grab your aim-bow..  and prepare to run The Riverguard Update !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/52edf7bd1bd6306af968c761b40715f38e387743.png
Denis

notes.title: Moonlight update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/59ceed1d738502d72ee8f4b451cb7d81cdc32497.png

The moonlight update brings a new look with better graphics, engine improvements and some touches to the gameplay.

Every map now uses the new art and the effect is quite beautiful, be it Guardiah Tower, the Ashan fields or the White Tower, wherever you go the new look follows covering the whole world!

About the combat I dropped the auto-targetting system used sometimes by Roy and Eria in favor of aimed attacks. This reduced the available mechanics but gives more satisfaction to your skills and attacks. 

And that's it for this update, a lot of work done but few lines ^^
So.. ready your WASD and good run !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/52edf7bd1bd6306af968c761b40715f38e387743.pngDenis

notes.title: "The Bridge of the Dead" patch 1.34
notes.notes:
On The Bridge of the Dead..
"You will fall..  ..and Your confidence will crumble..
..and so you'll join the endless guard..."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/404e0244cd36b83442e0d04cd917d44bbc2b315e.png

In  patch 1.34 a new challenge awaits you with the fighter class,  a new level, Feats, improvements and more.

I asked Guardiah if I could restructure the Tower to add a new level and since I got his approval  "The Bridge of the Dead" is now waiting for you !
The reason for the new level is that I felt that the story progression could benefit from one more level so The Bridge was born and now you better..
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/d6c600b8cc71ae790c666fd2633b03a6f91a3921.gif..prepare your spin kick as Roy will unleash his might against the undead guarding the bridge.  With their spells sealed by the mysterious mage, Roy has no choice but to rely on his fighter abilities to protect Eria and reach the World Compass. But even if the new fighter class is quite powerful the undead will test your strength and ambush you from any corner.  And if you feel confident the Monster difficulty is there for you ! 

The patch brings general polishing and better end-screens for the runner mode. 
It also changes the way the records are displayed in the Kyvedy Trials and now the last page will show your global scores as well as how many feats you have completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/e58eedd6f9d59185071a75f73acf652589410957.pngBecause yes there are Feats now !  What are they about ? It's a secret as they are... secret feats ! A little npc in a certain place will give you hints about them but.. it's up to you to understand the clues and complete them !

So ready your WASD for The Bridge of The Dead and good run !
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/52edf7bd1bd6306af968c761b40715f38e387743.pngDenis  



Patch notes :
- removed glitches
- added butterflies
- new level: The Bridge
- fighter class
- 5 feats
- global records

notes.title: Heartbeat Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/480542b19463ca031baea9c1a23a418f10cd45ff.png

Reworked Lives ! 
Now you have 3 lives when you start a level and the Kyvedy Flame restores one heart each time you use it! The new mechanic is quite fun as you can use the Flame to both kill monsters and restore your life. 

A proper Tutorial !  
Instead of having the basics explained in the first floor of Guardiah, now each time you start a new adventure you will  enter the Tutorial Map for a quick tour of the game dynamics. There you will find NPCs giving you tips and once done you can access Riverguard from the World map any time you want. 

A lot of quality of life improvements
In this update I made a lot of improvements to the gameplay and went through any level to fine tune it and make it work with the new mechanics.  The result is a game experience less "rogue-like" and more enjoyable as a journey in a fantasy world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/52edf7bd1bd6306af968c761b40715f38e387743.png
Aaand that's all for this update !
Denis

notes.title: Boon rewire, Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101832/dd28f4aaa70e7b1786c7f3997da496d4318f7ce5.png

The Boon rewire update was meant to address a problem with flatpack in Linux that was "incompatible" with the game appimage. So, while that is fixed I decided to publish the new game modes as well !

Now from the options menu you can select from "classic" and "runner" mode.

The classic, or normal mode, is now the new default for the game and the "runner" mode is for those that want to push themself to the limits.. of speed!

The classic mode plays as you expect from an rpg: explore, understand what to do,  fight, progress in the story.

The runner mode instead adds a time limit for any map, the timer is always shown onscreen, so you can check out how you are faring, and in some levels the mechanics are different to give satisfaction to your speed bursts!

In addition The Welcoming Hall and The Merchant's Lobby have been reworked adding a new mechanic ! 

And that's all for the Boon rewire Update!

Good run!
Denis
